definitions.explanation: A level of image or display quality characterized by a large number of pixels, producing sharp and detailed visuals.

examples.japanese: {高解像度|こうかいぞうど}の{画面|がめん}は{目|め}に{優|やさ}しい。
examples.english: A high-resolution screen is easy on the eyes.

examples.japanese: このカメラは{高解像度|こうかいぞうど}の{写真|しゃしん}が{撮|と}れる。
examples.english: This camera can take high-resolution photos.

examples.japanese: {衛星|えいせい}から{高解像度|こうかいぞうど}の{画像|がぞう}を{取得|しゅとく}して{地形|ちけい}を{分析|ぶんせき}している。
examples.english: They are acquiring high-resolution images from satellites and analyzing the terrain.

notes:
Composed of {高|こう} (high) and {解像度|かいぞうど} (resolution). Widely used in technology, photography, and media contexts. The opposite is {低解像度|ていかいぞうど} (low resolution).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高解像度|こうかいぞうど}ディスプレイ — high-resolution display
- {高解像度|こうかいぞうど}{画像|がぞう} — high-resolution image
- {高解像度|こうかいぞうど}モニター — high-resolution monitor
- {高解像度|こうかいぞうど}で{印刷|いんさつ}する — to print in high resolution

RELATED WORDS:
- {解像度|かいぞうど} — resolution (the measurement itself)
- {高画質|こうがしつ} — high image quality (overlapping but focuses on overall quality, not just pixel count)
- 4K / 8K — ultra-high-definition display standards
